display.name: Coregw MVC — Lettuce Pool & Redis Server
display.description: Client/pool metrics belong to the selected app; Redis server panels belong to the exporter and include ALL clients. Compare equal traffic and separate time windows. Pool max-active is a limit, not a preallocated connection count.

display.name: Redis reachable
display.description: Current value. Includes all clients; app mode/environment filters do not scope Redis server metrics.

display.name: Connected clients
display.description: Current value. Includes all clients; app mode/environment filters do not scope Redis server metrics.

display.name: Redis allocated memory
display.description: Current value. Includes all clients; app mode/environment filters do not scope Redis server metrics.

display.name: Redis process RSS
display.description: Current value. Includes all clients; app mode/environment filters do not scope Redis server metrics.

display.name: GET / SET / HSET completion rate
display.description: Includes startup/prepare SETs; exclude those time windows for benchmark comparisons.

display.name: Command completion · mean
display.description: Lettuce client timing includes network and client scheduling; not Redis server execution alone.

display.name: Command completion · p90
display.description: Histogram estimate per JVM, Redis mode and command. Does not include Commons Pool acquisition.

display.name: Command completion · p99
display.description: Histogram estimate per JVM, Redis mode and command. Does not include Commons Pool acquisition.

display.name: Pool active / idle / limit
display.description: Active + idle = current pooled native connections. Limit is max-active; connections are created on demand.

display.name: Pool utilization · active / limit
display.description: Multiplexing has no Commons Pool series. A 5s scrape may miss short-lived saturation.

display.name: Callers waiting for a pooled connection
display.description: Sampled count, not Redis blocked_clients. A zero sample cannot rule out a short wait between scrapes.

display.name: Borrow wait · rolling mean / lifetime max
display.description: Commons Pool MXBean integer milliseconds; sub-ms waits can appear as 0. Max includes startup and is not a window p99.

display.name: Pool borrow rate
display.description: Cumulative borrow count exposed as gauge; rate is interpreted as borrows/s and resets on process restart.

display.name: Connection creations / destroys
display.description: Persistent churn after warm-up can explain higher CPU and latency. max-active does not preallocate connections.

display.name: Redis CPU · core equivalents
display.description: CPU seconds/s; 1.0 is one core. Not directly comparable to JVM capacity fraction.

display.name: Redis connected / blocked clients
display.description: Connected includes app, exporter and all other clients. Blocked means Redis blocking commands, not callers waiting for the Java pool.

display.name: Redis allocated / RSS memory
display.description: Redis allocator bytes vs physical resident process memory. RSS-minus-used is not proof of a leak.

display.name: Redis memory / configured maxmemory
display.description: No series when maxmemory=0 (unlimited); do not display 0% as healthy for an unlimited server.

display.name: Redis GET / SET / HSET throughput
display.description: Server-side command calls/s from ALL clients. Includes seeding and monitoring overhead.

display.name: Redis command execution · mean
display.description: Server execution mean from INFO commandstats, excluding client pool wait and network. Not a percentile.

display.name: Redis network input / output
display.description: All clients, including exporter.

display.name: Redis keyspace hits / misses
display.description: A cache miss is not necessarily an error. Benchmark preload keys are expected to hit.

display.name: Evictions / rejected connections
display.description: Memory pressure and connection-capacity failures. Do not infer success from low Redis command latency alone.

display.name: App / exporter scrape availability
display.description: Scrape and Redis up must be 1. Missing series is a telemetry gap, not zero usage.
